Ironwood Construction | Pro

A luxury WordPress design for builders, remodelers and construction professionals, with original illustrative architectural media.

Included

WordPress block theme ZIP, responsive design, native editable homepage, 2 style variations, blog/page/search templates, editable FAQs, and demo media.

Plugin requirements

Required for layout: None.

Required for live quote (if used): Forminator Forms. Install separately, configure and test. Not included in the theme ZIP. The theme works without it, but the booking/request workflow will not.

Needed only if you want a working quote/request form embedded on the site. The theme includes a styled contact section, not a working form.

Optional: Forminator Forms for general contact forms, WooCommerce for e-commerce. Their setup and possible paid extensions are not included.

Platform and purchase status

Self-hosted WordPress with block Site Editor. Not for static HTML hosting or WordPress.com plans without custom theme upload access.

Paid theme · Price and checkout to be announced. This is a prelaunch preview, not a completed purchase flow.

Setup

Upload the installable theme ZIP under WordPress → Appearance → Themes. See the included README and PLUGINS.md for complete installation and plugin instructions.

Release status: Theme code and static preview are packaged, but real WordPress installation, block editor behavior, plugin integration and production compatibility still require QA before sale.
